state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name = 'long_horizon_bench' AND state = 'created' AND start_after > now()
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name = 'long_horizon_bench' AND state = 'retry'
state_queries.dead: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name = 'long_horizon_bench' AND state = 'failed'
state_queries.running: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name LIKE 'long\_horizon\_bench%' AND state = 'active'

operator_notes: findJobs(queue, {id} | {data: {h}} | {data: {t}} | {data: {kind: 'bench_alt'}, queued: true}) with limit; count is getQueue().queuedCount (monitor-cached, 60 s); haystack via insert() into its own queue; no pause API, so each replica offWork()s on pause and work()s on resume
